headline: Hackers breach US Air Force Cloud One platform

members.title: Hackers acceden a la plataforma digital clave de la Fuerza Aérea de EE.UU.

summary: Multiple news reports say hackers gained access to the US Air Force’s Cloud One cloud computing platform, a key digital system, disrupting services and prompting an agency announcement about the intrusion. Coverage describes the breach as affecting the Air Force’s flagship cloud environment and notes impacts on military operations and data systems.

headline: Fuel tanker crash and fire kills around 31 people on Cairo highway

At least 31 killed as fuel tanker crash ignites large fire on Cairo highway

summary: A fuel tanker crashed and ignited a large fire on a Cairo highway, killing at least 30–31 people and injuring about 21 others; wreckage and burned vehicles were left at the scene after the explosion and blaze.

headline: U.S. approves SpaceX plan to launch one million satellites for space data centers

members.title: Donald Trump autorise Elon Musk à lancer un million de satellites dans l’espace pour créer des data centers
Estados Unidos autoriza a SpaceX a lanzar un millón de satélites para crear centros de datos espaciales
Así es Starmind, el proyecto de Elon Musk que ha aprobado Trump para poner en órbita un millón de satélites

summary: The U.S. government has authorized Elon Musk’s SpaceX to deploy up to one million satellites as part of a project called Starmind to establish data centers in orbit; the approval permits the large-scale satellite constellation intended to support space-based data storage and processing.

headline: France enters technical recession after two consecutive quarters of GDP decline

members.title: La croissance patine plus que prévu, la France techniquement en récession
La France en récession : le PIB a de nouveau reculé au troisième trimestre de 0,2 %
La France entre en récession, le PIB continue de reculer
La France est «techniquement» entrée en récession après deux trimestres consécutifs de recul de son PIB

summary: France's economy contracted for a second straight quarter, with GDP falling again in the third quarter, putting the country into a technical recession defined by two consecutive quarters of negative growth. The four articles agree that growth slowed more than expected and that the continued GDP decline marks a technical recession.

summary: Costa Rica refused to allow Francesca Albanese, the United Nations special rapporteur on the situation of human rights in the Palestinian territories, to enter the country; Albanese said she felt humiliated, and the UN has called on Costa Rica to reconsider the decision.

headline: 22-year-old man charged after regional train derailment in Normandy

members.title: Déraillement d’un TER en Normandie : un jeune déficient intellectuel mis en examen pour «blessures involontaires»
Déraillement d’un TER en Seine-Maritime : un homme de 22 ans mis en examen
Déraillement d'un TER en Seine-Maritime : un homme de 22 ans mis en examen pour vol et blessures involontaires

summary: A 22-year-old man has been placed under formal investigation in connection with a TER regional train derailment in Seine-Maritime, Normandy; he faces charges including involuntary bodily harm and, in some reports, theft. Articles indicate he is described as having an intellectual disability but do not provide further details about the incident or its casualties.

summary: A confidential informant testified that a senior Tétouan police official warned him roughly three weeks (about 20 days) before a large group entered Ceuta, indicating the official had foreknowledge of the planned mass entry.

headline: Edmundo González to end exile in Spain and return to Venezuela

members.title: Edmundo González pone fin a su exilio en Madrid: volverá a Venezuela para el 5 de diciembre
Edmundo González anuncia su regreso a Venezuela la próxima semana tras más de dos años exiliado en España

summary: Edmundo González, who has been living in exile in Madrid for more than two years, has announced he will return to Venezuela next week, with his planned arrival around December 5.

headline: UK Ministry of Labour reports cyber incident and suspends multiple services

members.title: Royaume-Uni : le ministère du travail déclare un « cyberincident » et met plusieurs de ses services hors ligne
Un ciberataque suspende numerosos servicios del Ministerio de Trabajo y Pensiones de Reino Unido

summary: The UK Ministry of Labour (Department for Work and Pensions/Ministry of Work) declared a cyber incident and took several online services offline; the attack forced suspension of numerous ministry services while officials assess the impact and restore systems.

headline: Manuel Ramírez, influential independent publisher, has died

members.title: Muere Manuel Ramírez, el editor discreto del prestigioso sello Pre-Textos
Muere Manuel Ramírez, uno de los grandes editores independientes de España
Muere Manuel Ramírez, el entusiasta silencioso como molde del buen editor

summary: Manuel Ramírez, the long-time editor behind the respected independent Spanish publishing house Pre-Textos, has died. The three articles agree he was a discreet, enthusiastic figure who played a central role in shaping Pre-Textos’s editorial identity and was widely regarded as one of Spain’s leading independent editors.
